name: Bloodletter

bonuses.name: Locus of Fury
bonuses.text: Anyone who makes a melee attack within 2 metres of this Threat (including itself) may reroll any 1s on their Weapon Skill Tests. Complications may not be rerolled in this way.

abilities.name: Frightful Form
abilities.text: Anyone that can see this Threat must make a DN 3 Fear Test

abilities.name: Blood for the Blood God!
abilities.text: If this Threat rolls a Wrath Critical as part of an attack, the target suffers the Bleeding Condition in addition to any other effects.

determination: Daemonic Determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 6d6. Daemons can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.

options.name: Bloodreaper
options.text: A Bloodreaper may lead Bloodletters in battle, using the same statistics with the following adjustments: SKILLS: Default 9, Awareness 11 (Passive 6), Intimidate 10, Weapon Skill 11. BONUS: Blood Must Flow!: Whenever a Critical Hit or a Bleeding Condition is suffered within 10m of a Bloodreaper, the GM gains 1 Ruin.

abilities.name: Howl of Rage
abilities.text: The Bloodreaper makes an Intimidation Interaction Attack, with +1 bonus dice for every Bloodletter within 5m.

abilities.name: Wrathful Summoning
abilities.text: Whenever a Bloodreaper rolls a 6 on the Wrath Die, a Bloodletter is summoned from the Warp.
